rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the state or quality of spending time alone, without implying sadness or loneliness.

example.english: I sometimes enjoy solitariness and quietly read a book by myself.
example.traditional: 我有時鍾意自己一個人獨處，靜靜咁睇書。
